_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::ale#2 and the execution that FALSIFIED its Signal. The entry claimed a linear StVenantKirchhoff ALE material under >30 degrees of rotation gives inverted elements and an abort on 'negative Jacobian'. There is no such string in 4C and no abort. On upstream ale2d_solid_nln_large_rot (inner boundary through 60 degrees) ELAST_CoupLogNeoHooke converges on every step; MAT_Struct_StVenantKirchhoff at the same YOUNG/NUE stalls on 3 steps, where 4C prints 'ALE newton not converged in 10 iterations. Continue' and carries on to the end of the schedule. The tracked node is then wrong by 2.24e-1 against 4.14e-1, and only the deck's own result test notices. So the corrected claim is a SILENT STALL, not an abort. Runtime ~100 s for both arms. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
